title: SQL 注入正反两组：字符串拼接 vs 参数化绑定（真实执行）
expected_output:
=== SQL 注入: 字符串拼接 vs 参数化绑定 ===
输入的账号 = x
输入的密码 = ' OR '1'='1' --
--- 反例 1: 字符串拼接 ---
实际执行的 SQL = SELECT id, uname, role FROM users WHERE uname = 'x' AND pwd = '' OR '1'='1' --'
返回行数 = 3
返回内容 = [(1, 'alice', 'admin'), (2, 'bob', 'user'), (3, 'carol', 'user')]
越权读到全部用户 = True
--- 正例 1: 参数化绑定(占位符) ---
返回行数 = 0  返回内容 = []
越权读到全部用户 = False
--- 反例 2: 破坏性注入(多语句) ---
载荷 = "x'; DROP TABLE users; --"
execute() 拒绝多语句: ProgrammingError - You can only execute one statement at a time.
executescript 放行多语句后 users 表已被破坏: no such table: users
--- 正例 2: 参数化 + 单语句执行为何安全 ---
把载荷当普通字符串比较: 返回行数 = 0
users 表仍完好: 行数 = 3
结论: 参数化绑定让载荷只能作为「值」，无法改变语句结构
code:
import sqlite3

SETUP = "CREATE TABLE users(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, uname TEXT, role TEXT, pwd TEXT);"
ROWS = [(1, "alice", "admin", "A1"), (2, "bob", "user", "B2"), (3, "carol", "user", "C3")]


def fresh():
    con = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
    con.execute(SETUP)
    con.executemany("INSERT INTO users(id,uname,role,pwd) VALUES (?,?,?,?)", ROWS)
    return con


PAYLOAD = "' OR '1'='1' --"
print("=== SQL 注入: 字符串拼接 vs 参数化绑定 ===")
print("输入的账号 = x")
print("输入的密码 =", PAYLOAD)

print("--- 反例 1: 字符串拼接 ---")
con = fresh()
sql_bad = "SELECT id, uname, role FROM users WHERE uname = '%s' AND pwd = '%s'" % ("x", PAYLOAD)
print("实际执行的 SQL =", sql_bad)
rows = con.execute(sql_bad).fetchall()
print("返回行数 =", len(rows))
print("返回内容 =", rows)
print("越权读到全部用户 =", len(rows) == 3)
con.close()

print("--- 正例 1: 参数化绑定(占位符) ---")
con = fresh()
rows = con.execute("SELECT id, uname, role FROM users WHERE uname = ? AND pwd = ?",
                   ("x", PAYLOAD)).fetchall()
print("返回行数 =", len(rows), " 返回内容 =", rows)
print("越权读到全部用户 =", len(rows) == 3)

print("--- 反例 2: 破坏性注入(多语句) ---")
print("载荷 =", repr("x'; DROP TABLE users; --"))
try:
    con.execute("SELECT 1; DROP TABLE users;")
except Exception as e:
    print("execute() 拒绝多语句:", type(e).__name__, "-", e)
con.executescript("SELECT 1; DROP TABLE users;")
try:
    con.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users").fetchone()
except sqlite3.OperationalError as e:
    print("executescript 放行多语句后 users 表已被破坏:", e)
con.close()

print("--- 正例 2: 参数化 + 单语句执行为何安全 ---")
con = fresh()
rows = con.execute("SELECT id, uname FROM users WHERE uname = ?", (PAYLOAD,)).fetchall()
print("把载荷当普通字符串比较: 返回行数 =", len(rows))
print("users 表仍完好: 行数 =", con.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users").fetchone()[0])
con.close()
print("结论: 参数化绑定让载荷只能作为「值」，无法改变语句结构")
